notes.title: Update 2019.05.27.
notes.content:
- [SlowMovement] has been added. ( default key : Left Shift )
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34941711/da7c29292027889773e5c62bed42a1febd80a729.png[/img]

- [AutoFire] has been added. ( Setting Menu )
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34941711/59516567876afb97a8a8724f6097426fcc370fcc.png[/img]

- When Under Attack, it will remain invincible for 0.2 seconds.

- Boss HP : It is displayed in more granular detail.

- Minor bug fixes ( Joystick Cancel Button ... )

I'll continue to reflect your good opinions in the future.
今後ともあなたの良い意見を反映させていきます。
今后我将继续反映你的良好见解。
앞으로도 좋은 의견을 계속 반영하겠습니다.
Ich werde die guten Meinungen weiterhin anwenden.
В будущем я буду продолжать отражать хорошее мнение.

Thank you..!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34941711/8deb9e00e246be5a496250a12988123181985e13.png[/img]
※ Additional stages (DLC) are still being developed.
